_README: Every line and flavour legible in the shop's own 48MP photographs, read frame by frame at native resolution. This is what is ON THE SHELF, not what the brands make - the difference is the entire point, and it is why nothing here should ever be topped up from a manufacturer's catalogue. `legibility`: clear = printed name read unambiguously, partial = most read and the rest a confident completion, inferred = packaging recognised but the name not actually legible.
